Subject: Request: CSA subset mapping + evidence for provisioning/scope

Hi Soojin —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. BlueHorizon needs a compact CAIQ crosswalk for the set of controls we scoped (network, key management, tenant isolation, runtime telemetry). Our external audit window opens 2028-08-02 so we need the mapping and any supporting artifacts by 2028-07-20 to give our auditors a week to ingest.

Can you:
- Provide a control-catalogue that maps your CSA/CAIQ claim IDs to our control IDs (we sent the scope list as attachment).
- Include at least one sample runtime log extract for A.11 (telemetry) and a short note on redaction/PII handling.
- Flag any controls you intend to meet with compensating controls (we’ll accept short narratives).

If you prefer to hand this over in two passes (draft mapping + final artifacts), that’s fine — just let me know the ETA.

Emily Carter
Director, Vendor Assurance
BlueHorizon Health
controls@bluehorizon.com

Attachments: BH_scope_controls_20280709.pdf

Emily —

Appreciate the clear ask. We’ll prepare a two-pass delivery: a draft control catalogue today/tomorrow and a final evidence bundle by 2028-07-19 (one day ahead of your internal buffer).

What I’m going to include in the draft:
- CAIQ_control_catalogue_v0.1.xlsx — mapping columns: our_claim_id, your_control_id, mapped_evidence_refs, owner, notes
- owner_roster_20280713.csv — control owners for quick escalation
- a short narrative for any compensating control decisions we expect (marked "COMP")

Notes/asks for you:
- For telemetry samples, do you want full-format log lines or redacted tokenized examples? We typically provide a small redacted sample plus raw extracts under an encrypted transfer if needed.
- Confirm whether the auditors need DocuSign-backed attestation or a signed cover letter.

I’ll route the draft to Marissa to attach the evidence index and a log sample (Jonas will pull the KV/cache sample).

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
